name: Label the Plant Cell
description: Students label an unlabelled plant cell by drawing arrows and writing part names right on the diagram, then explain what the chloroplast does. Teacher-graded: SpeedGrader shows the finished drawing and replays it stroke by stroke.
author: Virtual Arkansas

parameters.label: Parts to label (comma-separated)
parameters.default: cell wall, cell membrane, nucleus, chloroplast, vacuole, mitochondrion
